name: suta
description: An agent skill that fixes the parts of a UI that look AI-made. Claude Code and Codex read it on every UI request: rules for layout, type, color and motion, code for 57 UI patterns, and a layout and motion check after each file edit. Demo: https://guksu.github.io/suta/

interface.shortDescription: Rules and 57 UI patterns that fix the parts of a UI that look AI-made
interface.longDescription: Read on every UI request. It blocks what makes a UI look AI-made: cards inside cards, animations that shake the layout, ignored reduced-motion settings, components you cannot use with a keyboard. The agent reuses code from 57 UI patterns, and a layout and motion check runs after each file edit.
